kits.name: ad-claims-check
kits.title: Ad claims against your source of truth
kits.summary: Sets what Meta says its ads produced beside what your source of truth recorded on the same days, and shows the gap without blaming either side.

kits.name: cash-cycle
kits.title: Cash cycle and weeks of cover
kits.summary: Works out how many days cash is tied up between paying suppliers and getting paid, and the weeks of stock on hand against the supplier's lead time, from the store's cost of goods and the owner's own figures.

kits.name: channel-claim-audit
kits.title: Channel claim audit
kits.summary: Once a month, checks each ad platform's claimed revenue against Shopify net revenue and against its own history, with four pass, watch or fail checks, and names channels whose numbers should not drive budget until a holdout test settles them.

kits.name: cm-waterfall
kits.title: Contribution margin waterfall
kits.summary: Lays out contribution margin layer by layer (after product costs, after shipping and fees, after ad spend) for the last 30 days beside the 30 before and the last 90, and names the layer that moved.

kits.name: flow-audit
kits.title: Flow audit
kits.summary: Finds missing, silent and declining Klaviyo flows, with evidence for each finding.

kits.name: holdout-planner
kits.title: Holdout test planner
kits.summary: Designs a holdout test a small store can actually run (a welcome email holdout, or a region held back from one ad channel) sized from its own orders, with the split, the duration, the one number to read and the decision rule written before it starts.

kits.name: marginal-return
kits.title: Marginal return
kits.summary: Reads what the last step up or down in a channel's spend did to Shopify net revenue, new orders and margin after ads, by comparing two spend levels, and gives scale, hold or cut against the store's own break-even.

kits.name: meta-ads-diagnosis
kits.title: Meta ads diagnosis
kits.summary: Reads a Meta ad account against the owner's funnel numbers, names the one constraint (leads, bookings, shows or closes), and writes a funnel diagnosis report with kill, keep and scale calls the owner approves.

kits.name: meta-spend-check
kits.title: Meta spend check
kits.summary: A weekly read-only look at Meta ad spend against Shopify net revenue, with Meta's own purchase claims kept apart and labeled.

kits.name: packaging-review
kits.title: Packaging review
kits.summary: Sends a title, thumbnail idea, hook, script or post to Cosmic Cloud's packaging review and shows the verdict, the fixes and the rewrites. Pro and Agency.
kits.writes: Nothing. It shows the review in the conversation, and saves a copy on this computer only if the owner asks.

kits.name: revenue-per-flow
kits.title: Revenue per flow
kits.summary: Ranks flows by attributed revenue per recipient and shows the share of Shopify revenue.

kits.name: saas-funnel
kits.title: SaaS funnel and churn
kits.summary: A monthly look at a subscription business from Stripe, covering visits to paid, new paying customers, MRR and net new MRR, churn and failed payments, and blended cost per new customer.

kits.name: static-ads
kits.title: Static ads
kits.summary: Finds the angles a brand's running Meta ads miss, proposes five concepts, and generates the images the owner picks on the owner's own Kie or fal key.
kits.writes: A concepts file, image files, prompts and a cost ledger on this computer. Uploads to Meta only as a separate step the owner approves.

kits.name: store-health-check
kits.title: Store health check
kits.summary: Reads the status of every source and the reconcile checks, then tells the owner in plain words what to fix first.

kits.name: ugc-video
kits.title: UGC video
kits.summary: Writes a short presenter script from the brand's site and reviews, renders voice and an AI presenter on the owner's own accounts, checks the render word by word, and adds captions.
kits.writes: A script, voice and video files, captions, a word check and a cost ledger on this computer. Uploads to Meta only as a separate step the owner approves.

kits.name: weekly-numbers
kits.title: Weekly numbers
kits.summary: A Monday summary built from verified metrics only, leading with the trust line and how fresh each source is.

kits.name: weekly-pipeline
kits.title: Weekly pipeline numbers
kits.summary: A Monday page of B2B pipeline numbers checked against HubSpot's own counts, with leads and pipeline by original source and cost per lead beside pipeline created.

kits.name: winback-segment
kits.title: Win-back segment
kits.summary: Proposes a win-back segment from the brand's own repeat timing, and creates it only after review.
kits.writes: one Klaviyo segment, after a reviewed plan and --confirm. Never sends.
